pattern.description: The 3D character drops into a throne and a crown falls onto its head, while the background strobes through yellow starburst and white/yellow flashes before settling on flat pink; slight camera pull-out.
pattern.why_premium: Frame-accurate background strobes and the impact sound land exactly on the narration's punchline ('king of the board'), giving a cartoon payoff without any text.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(character, {y: -120, rotate: -8}, {y: 0, rotate: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}); tl.set(bg, {backgroundColor: '#ffe100'}, '<0.1') with a starburst SVG tl.fromTo(burst, {scale: 0.6, rotate: -10}, {scale: 1.2, rotate: 5, duration: 0.2, ease: 'none'}); tl.set(bg, {backgroundColor: '#fff'}), tl.set(bg, {backgroundColor: '#ffe100'}), then tl.set(bg, {backgroundColor: '#ffa6d6'}) about 2-3 frames apart; tl.fromTo(crown, {y: -300}, {y: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.in'}); camera wrapper scale 1.05 to 1 over the whole beat, ease 'power1.out'.
build_hint.remotion: Background colour chosen by frame range (step function, no interpolation) from an array [pink, yellow+burst, white, yellow, pink]; character and crown translateY via interpolate with Easing.in(Easing.cubic) and clamp; wrapper scale interpolate(frame, [0, 30], [1.05, 1]).

notes: Camera verdict is pull_out (scale 0.953). Shot starts with the character already falling in from above. The background flashes are hard step changes, so easing is a guess.
